children: Xponential Fitness named Jennifer Ryu as its next chief financial officer, effective Oct. 19.

Ryu will succeed interim CFO Robert Julian, who has been in the role since March amid a search process for a permanent appointment. Julian will stay on as a consultant with the company to support the transition.
Ryu was most recently CFO of professional services firm Resources Connection, and has held finance leadership roles at Young's Holdings and Kaiser Aluminum.
